title: Define the project
description: Set the project scope, review precedent vehicles, and establish initial requirements.

title: Pivot to aerial response
description: Redirect the project from a hybrid aerial-underwater vehicle to a high-speed FPV emergency response and reconnaissance drone.

title: Design the airframe
description: Develop and compare frame concepts for fast, stable FPV flight.

title: Select motors and propellers
description: Evaluate motors, propellers, and batteries for speed and flight time.

title: Simulate flight and failsafes
description: Use simulation to estimate thrust, stability, and return-home behavior.

title: Build the first prototype
description: Assemble the airframe, propulsion system, and electronics for testing.

title: Bench and flight testing
description: Measure thrust, tune flight control, and test controlled flight.

title: Integrate and demonstrate
description: Integrate live video and FPGA functionality, then demonstrate a simulated emergency-response mission.
